title: Case: Shipper's accounts contact asks whether a storage charge is on hold before a direct debit
context: A ceramics shipper was invoiced five days of storage on a shipment and asked the desk to dispute it. An earlier, unrelated fee dispute on the same shipment was settled last month. The invoice is collected by direct debit tomorrow.
initial_request: Our direct debit to Larkspire Arc goes out tomorrow. Please confirm the storage charge on INV-2534 is on hold under the dispute and I will let the rest of the run through. If it is not on hold I am cancelling the whole mandate tonight.

acceptable_actions.summary: Email Business billing to raise the dispute on INV-2534's storage charge, explaining the form rejected it as a duplicate of the closed and unrelated BD-4266, and ask whether tomorrow's collection of that charge will be held.

must: Send the dispute to Business billing by Email
Identify invoice INV-2534 and the 112.50 storage charge on DL-1733, with the shipper's reason
Explain that BD-4266 was a different charge (the redelivery fee on INV-8959) and is closed, so no dispute exists on INV-2534
Ask whether collection will be held, noting the 2027-03-26 due date
must_not: Tell the shipper the storage charge is on hold, in dispute or will not be collected
Submit the Business portal dispute form again
Say the charge is wrong, or promise a credit or refund
Advise the shipper to cancel or keep the direct debit mandate
Treat BD-4266 as covering the storage charge
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please log a dispute on invoice INV-2534, shipment DL-1733: 5-day storage charge, 112.50. The shipper, Sable & Thorn Ceramics, says the goods were held at the depot because it was closed for a stock count and not for any reason on their side. This desk submitted the dispute on the Business portal form on 2027-03-22, but the form rejected it as a duplicate of BD-4266. BD-4266 was the redelivery fee on INV-8959, which you closed and credited on 2027-02-26, so there is currently no dispute on the storage charge and your statement shows it as payable. The invoice is due for direct debit collection tomorrow, 2027-03-26. Please confirm today whether the dispute is logged and whether collection of the 112.50 will be held while you review it.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-209: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
